description: Grids from the oracle's real constructor at a fixed mask, captured at its _draw_codewords and _apply_mask calls. Metadata = cells written by _draw_format_bits/_draw_version except the one cell dark for every level and mask (the dark module); metadata cells are cleared to light in fixed/unmasked/masked grids. Grid hex: row-major, one bit per cell, MSB first, zero-padded; grid SHA-256: one 0/1 byte per cell. Placement codewords byte i = (149*i + floor(i/251) + 31*version) mod 256, injected in place of the oracle's correction output; symbol data as in the correction vectors.
